svg.title: Timing faults during the load trial
svg.desc: Under the same 30 kilowatt load, one update 3 seconds late lets the water fall to 33.21 degrees Celsius, 1 second sampling settles in 18.9 seconds like the normal trial, and a program that tells the controller 0.1 seconds while it updates every 0.5 seconds leaves the water 0.78 degrees low after 30 seconds.
svg.text: Timing faults during the 30 kW load trial
Control Studio validation trials of this project · set B, β = 0.8, Tf = 1 s · numbers answer the predictions
Assumed interval: still 0.78 °C low at 30 s
